turns.replyText:
My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If tracking shows delivered but you do not have the package, please follow these steps:
Check around the delivery location
Look around doors, side entrances, garage, mailbox area, or reception/front desk.
Ask neighbors or building management in case it was left nearby.
Review the tracking details carefully
Sometimes the carrier notes where the package was left.
In some cases, a package marked delivered may arrive a little later the same day.
Contact the carrier directly
Ask for delivery details or GPS/drop-off confirmation if available.
They may be able to help locate the package more quickly.
If you still cannot locate it, contact us for further assistance
A human representative may be better suited to review next steps with you.
